champion.tips: KAI'SA TIPS AND TRICKS Kai’Sa benefits from mixed damaging items. Buying items that will provide AD, AP and attack speed will give you a variety of evolved skills. Kai'Sa's Ultimate R is a long-range dash that gives her a big shield. Try to reposition yourself with it in a team fight so you can survive long enough to deal a lot of damage. Try and use your Q on the enemy when they’re isolated and not near minions. This will force your Q to focus just the enemy champion which will, in turn, mean they take more damage and be easier to kill.
champion.builds: THE BEST KAI'SA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kai'Sa Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Kraken Slayer as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Nashor's Tooth, Zhonya's Hourglass and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.8% winrate over 187 640 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kai'Sa Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Kraken Slayer, which you should build first, followed by Berserker's Greaves as your second item and Guinsoo's Rageblade as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Nashor's Tooth, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 50.1% win rate over 7 568 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Statikk Shiv as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Guinsoo's Rageblade as a third item. You want to finish the build with Nashor's Tooth, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 48.5% win rate across 5 436 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kai'Sa Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Yun Tal Wildarrows as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Infinity Edge as third item. The last 3 options are Phantom Dancer, Lord Dominik's Regards and Bloodthirster. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 49.0% win rate over 1 919 matches played. Situational Kai'Sa Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kai'Sa build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kai'Sa runes page.
